# Enrolled systems

A system is listed here only after its maintainers enrolled it themselves, with the [registration form](https://github.com/agentic-datacenter/agentic-datacenter/issues/new?template=gate-registration.yml), and agreed to be listed by name. Each row links that registration. Every system is listed under the same rules, in the order of its name. `relation` says whether its maintainers are independent of this project or are among its authors (`benchmark_authors`). Being listed is not an endorsement, by this project of the system or by the system of this project.

## What each system brings

A system need not decide anything to take part. It says what it brings:

- **decisions**: decides on each proposed action;
- **findings**: states what it found, such as whether a mandate holds, without deciding;
- **evidence**: gives records or receipts of its own that others can check;
- **verification**: checks evidence that this project or another system made;

| System | Relation | Brings |
| --- | --- | --- |

## Findings

A finding is a weakness a run showed. It goes to the system's maintainers first, and is described here once they have fixed it or agreed to its publication. Until then it is counted and not described.
